text: From PanelVerse — Happy Diwali & blessed Kali Puja.
Tonight Bengal glows — diyas, dhak beats, Ma Kali's thunder.
Among the Mahavidyas — the second is Tara Ma.
She saves souls, ferries across darkness — a star of hope.
Shiva shook from the poison of the churning sea; creation trembled.
Tara arose in blue — warrior Mother, tender heart, light in fearful night.
She nursed Shiva; the throat-fire cooled; life returned to earth.
Tara means crossing fear — deliverance from every crisis.
At Tarapith's burning ground, an eternal lamp still glows.
In Kolkata and Bengal's homes — Tara Ma's diya burns tonight.
Call in fear and Mother answers — illusion falls to her scissors.
Truth in the skull-cup — wrath and compassion in one gaze.
Diwali light and Kali night meet on the Hooghly's shore.
Light your lamp; bow your head to Tara Ma.
This Kali Puja night — may Tara Ma's grace stay beside you.
Jay Ma Kali. Jay Ma Tara.
